connectors.name: figma
connectors.description: Pull component specs, typography scales and spacing tokens from our Cupertino UI Figma file.
samplePrompts: Fetch the latest Liquid Glass Button specs (frame id: 45:812).
List typography styles for iOS 26 Headline and Title text.
connectors.usage: Use before implementing or updating any component referenced in .roadmap/plan.md to keep parity with design.

connectors.name: dev-tools
connectors.description: Record network traces + performance metrics for Storybook stories or Vite playground builds.
samplePrompts: Open Storybook story 'Organisms/TabBar' and capture the performance profile while switching tabs.
Inspect console logs for AIPromptInput interactions in Home landing page.
connectors.usage: Run after major UI changes to ensure no warnings/errors and to capture metrics for release notes.

connectors.name: playwright
connectors.description: Automate visual + interaction regression flows (SpotlightSearch, QuickAction grid, templates).
samplePrompts: Run Playwright smoke suite on Storybook to verify SpotlightSearch keyboard navigation.
Capture screenshot diffs for src/pages/Home hero interactions.
connectors.usage: Trigger before merges touching navigation, overlays, or AI components.
